bias.en: Bearish turn · lost the 30-day, SAR flipped
bias.zh: 转弱 · 失守 30 日均线，SAR 翻空

read.en: SpaceX fell 2.8% on Oct 14 to $152.16; with 86 sessions of history it has no 100 or 200-day averages yet. It is below its 5-day ($159.1), 10-day ($161.3) and 30-day ($153.3) averages. MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 14 and is still above zero, Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Oct 14 ($176.4), and RSI is 48.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月14日下跌 2.8%，收于 $152.16；上市仅 86 个交易日，尚无 100 日和 200 日均线。股价位于 5 日（$159.1）、10 日（$161.3）和 30 日均线（$153.3）下方。MACD 于 10月14日下穿信号线，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 于 10月14日转为看空（$176.4），RSI 为 48。

read.en: The $153–154.6 support (30-day average and SAR) broke on the close, flipping the SAR as flagged in the last read; the day's low was $151.10. Resistance is now $153.3–156 (30-day average, Oct 13 low), then $159–161 (5 and 10-day) and $167.5. Support is $145.4 (Sep 28 low), $143 (Sep 15 low) and $130.4 (Aug 20 low). A close below $143 would open $130.
read.zh: $153–154.6 支撑（30 日均线及 SAR）收盘失守，SAR 如上次分析所提示转为看空；当日低点 $151.10。阻力现为 $153.3–156（30 日均线、10月13日低点），其次 $159–161（5 日和 10 日均线）和 $167.5。支撑为 $145.4（9月28日低点）、$143（9月15日低点）和 $130.4（8月20日低点）。若收盘跌破 $143，下一目标看 $130。
